title: Overview of the TREC 2025 Product Search and Recommendation Track
abstract: arXiv:2608.17138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the past few years, consumers have moved the bulk of their product exploration and purchasing efforts online seeking speed, convenience, and price comparison with ease unimaginable for in-person shopping. As product catalogs have grown in diversity and size product search and recommendation have become a cornerstone for e-commerce sites.   Despite the widespread usage of search engines in e-commerce, there is no high-quality dataset designed to evaluate end-to-end retrieval quality. translated_title: TREC 2025产品搜索与推荐任务概述
translated_abstract: 过去几年，消费者将大部分产品探索和购买活动转移到线上，追求速度、便利和价格比较，这种便捷性是线下购物难以想象的。随着产品目录在多样性和规模上的增长，产品搜索和推荐已成为电子商务网站的基石。尽管搜索引擎在电子商务中广泛使用，但目前尚无高质量的数据集来评估端到端的检索质量。2025年，我们运行了此前在TREC 2023和TREC 2024中开展的产品搜索任务的修订和延续版本。2025年的产品搜索任务包括两个子任务：查询扩展和相关产品推荐。其中，相关产品推荐任务尤为新颖，提供了一个标注的产品关系数据集，用于区分互补产品和相关产品。我们预计该任务的数据将有助于更好地推动相关研究。
tldr: 本文介绍了TREC 2025产品搜索与推荐任务，重点提出了一个新颖的相关产品推荐数据集，用于区分互补和相关产品，以推动电子商务端到端检索质量的评估。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the TREC 2025 product search and recommendation track, highlighting a novel related-product recommendation dataset that distinguishes complementary and related products to advance e-commerce end-to-end retrieval evaluation.
